evidence.claim: Dr. Schär produce dal 1981 a Postal prodotti senza glutine per grande distribuzione, farmacie e ristorazione e opera in 11 paesi con 18 sedi.
evidence.quote: Since 1981, the heart of the company has been in Postal, near Merano: the headquarters host the global functions for all areas of expertise and the production facility where iconic products such as Wholesome Loaf are created. || From South Tyrol to the world We operate in 11 countries with 18 locations. || supplying gluten-free products to retailers, pharmacies and the food service sector
